service_area.note: Homes and small businesses in Sandpoint, Idaho and the towns around it: north to Bonners Ferry, south to Athol and Bayview, west to Priest River and Priest Lake, and east to Clark Fork.

services.name: Furnace repair: gas, propane, oil and electric furnaces that won't start, short-cycle, blow cold air or make noise
Boiler and hydronic heat repair: radiant floors, baseboard and radiators
Heat pump and ductless mini-split repair and service
Air conditioning repair: an AC that isn't cooling or won't turn on
Tune-up for a furnace, boiler, heat pump, mini-split or AC
Water heater repair or replacement, tank and tankless
Leak, pipe and fixture repair: leaking pipes, dripping faucets, running or leaking toilets
Free estimate for a furnace, heat pump, boiler or water heater replacement, or a remodel
Emergency visit: no heat in freezing weather, a burst or frozen pipe, or a leak that can't be stopped

not_offered: Appliance repair such as dishwashers or washing machines
pricing: Service visits have a $95 diagnostic fee, which is waived if the customer approves the repair.
A furnace or boiler tune-up is $149. A heat pump, mini-split or AC tune-up is $139.
Estimates for furnace, heat pump, boiler or water heater replacement are free.
Emergency visits on nights, Sundays and holidays add a $175 after-hours fee.
We don't quote repair or replacement prices over the phone. The technician gives a firm price on site before any work starts.

booking.note: Each service is its own booking. An emergency visit can be booked into the earliest window with a short lead time, even if that window is otherwise full.

owner.label: the owner's cell
owner.when: Any hour: an emergency, an upset customer, or a caller who asks for the owner. Take the caller's message first, so nothing is lost if nobody answers.

faqs.a: Yes. Peak is licensed and fully insured. (Demo shop.)

faqs.q: What payment methods do you take?
faqs.a: Credit and debit cards, checks and cash. The technician takes payment when the job is done.

Labor is guaranteed for one year. Parts carry the manufacturer's warranty.

Yes. The technician calls or texts about 30 minutes before arriving.

faqs.q: Does someone need to be home for the visit?
faqs.a: Yes. An adult needs to be home for the whole window to let the technician in.

faqs.q: Do you service wood or pellet stoves?
faqs.a: I don't have details on stoves or fireplaces. I can take a message and the technician will call you back.

faqs.q: How fast can you get here if I have no heat?
faqs.a: No heat in freezing weather and burst pipes get the earliest emergency slot, or I can try the owner's cell. I can't promise an arrival time beyond the window that's booked.

never_say: Never promise an arrival time narrower than the booked two-hour window.
Never guess what is wrong or say a problem is probably minor.
Never give advice about gas, wood or pellet stoves, fireplaces or chimneys.
Never offer discounts, coupons or promotions.

approved_tips.when: a furnace that won't come on
approved_tips.tip: You can check that the thermostat is set to heat, that its batteries aren't dead, and that the switch on or near the furnace is on.

approved_tips.when: a furnace that turns on and off every few minutes
approved_tips.tip: You can check whether the furnace filter looks clogged and swap in a new one if it does.

approved_tips.when: a heat pump or mini-split that isn't heating or cooling
approved_tips.tip: You can check that the thermostat or remote is on the right mode and that its breaker hasn't tripped; if it trips again, leave it off.

approved_tips.when: an air conditioner that isn't cooling
approved_tips.tip: You can check that the thermostat is set to cool, that its batteries aren't dead, and that the air filter isn't clogged.

approved_tips.when: a frozen pipe that hasn't burst
approved_tips.tip: You can open the faucet a little and keep that area warm, but please don't use an open flame to thaw it.

approved_tips.when: a slow leak or drip under a sink
approved_tips.tip: You can turn off the small valve under the sink and keep a bucket or towel under it in the meantime.

approved_tips.when: a toilet that keeps running or leaks
approved_tips.tip: You can turn off the valve on the wall behind the toilet, clockwise, to stop the water in the meantime.
Please don't use chemical drain cleaners on it; they can damage the pipes and make the repair unsafe.

approved_tips.when: no hot water from an electric water heater
approved_tips.tip: You can check whether the water heater's breaker has tripped and switch it back on once; if it trips again, leave it off.

approved_tips.when: a tankless water heater showing an error code
approved_tips.tip: Please write down the error code; you can also turn the unit off and back on once at its power switch.
